image_pixel_policy: Original PNG bytes, copied without resampling, alpha editing or any pixel modification.
scope: Nobunaga hurt, stunned, down, recovering and launched only; 12 genuinely drawn source poses each.
anatomical_scale_notes: body_height is upright anatomical skull-to-sole equivalent, excluding ponytail. Lying and airborne frames keep the same anatomical scale; horizontal bounding-box height is never used. Launched virtual feet follow pelvis plus half anatomical height to avoid using a rotating foot as the flight anchor.
validation: All 8 sheets are RGBA, independently viewed, complete separate figure counts (12 or 6), no alpha>90 at canvas edges, and registration creates 12 frames for each clip. Final in-game timing/scale acceptance remains with integration.

Generate a production 2D game sprite sheet of exactly the SAME Nobunaga character in BOTH reference sheets. Match the reference cel-shaded colorful illustrated style, exact face, moustache and pointed black beard, large black ponytail tied with red dotted band, RED lamellar chest and skirt armor with fine GOLD borders, dark plum baggy trousers, red shin armor, black-and-gold shoes, red cape with small gold flower pattern and gold edging, black sword sheath at waist and katana. Match the approved head-to-body ratio and stocky heroic physique, do not redesign or change head size. Adult man. Clear opaque painted interiors with crisp black outlines, sharp clean RGBA alpha edge, completely transparent empty background. NO lighting glow, NO outline glow, no aura, no drop shadows, no motion blur, no trails, no speed lines, no sparks, no blood, no icons, no words/numbers/grid. Only the separate character drawings. Full body, full hair and cape, full katana including point within each cell; sword held close and angled down to fit. Each drawing has unique changing joints/face/cape, genuine sequential animation poses, never duplicate pose with global wobble, never interpolation-smear. Camera is constant side/threequarter facing RIGHT. All drawings have IDENTICAL anatomical head/torso/limb scale, independently of crouching or lying; a flat lying person stays as large as the standing person's unfolded anatomy.

4. waist bends forward, left hand begins clutching belly
5. more pronounced bend, knees flex, painful closed-eye grimace
6. deepest forward fold, shoulders drawn together, clutch abdomen
7. body absorbs shock low, face twisted in pain, sword safe near hip
8. small rebound up, belly still held
9. bent posture begins to unfold slowly
10. knees extend slightly, shoulders remain hunched
11. nearly regained guard, eyes open slightly, still wincing
12. returned toward neutral ready, arms settle and cape settles
